RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is not evidence of unlawful bias or improper procedure. Panels frequently reflect available senior staff. Furthermore, the appointed candidate was shortlisted and possessed specific international project leadership experience that may have aligned better with the ministry's current needs or interview performance rubric.

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of irregular scoring or bias will appear groundless and could harm your professional reputation in the civil service. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your feedback and competency scores framed around your professional development. Only consider challenging the decision if the formal feedback demonstrates clear procedural flaws or a failure to apply the published merit criteria.
